recipe_catalog_entry.construct_name: Math Operation Box (ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV)
recipe_catalog_entry.ladder_syntax: [ADD In1, In2 -> Dest]  or  [SUB In1, In2 -> Dest]
recipe_catalog_entry.st_equivalent: Dest := In1 + In2;  or  Dest := In1 - In2;
recipe_catalog_entry.explanation: In Structured Text, arithmetic expressions use direct algebraic notation (+, -, *, /).

rungs.title: AlarmHighHigh Latch (Set Coil)
rungs.comment: Conditional latching coil activated when condition evaluates to TRUE

recipe_catalog_entry.ladder_syntax: ---(S Tag )---  or  ---(L Tag )---  or  OTL(Tag)  or  [SET Tag]
recipe_catalog_entry.explanation: A latch or set coil turns the output TRUE when rung condition is met, retaining state when condition goes FALSE.
recipe_catalog_entry.notes: In ST, write a conditional assignment: IF StartTrigger THEN LatchActive := TRUE; END_IF;
